notes.title: February 2025 update
notes.notes:
- Sound settings in the game are saved
- Changed VSync switching method
- Changed behavior of enemy npcs
- Registration of hits on enemies is now more accurate
- When calling the menu during the game it will now appear without a picture
- Added pause while opening the game menu
- Skeletons' health has been reduced and their damage has been slightly increased
- Walking sounds on some surfaces have been made quieter
- The player's magic projectiles have been accelerated by 5 times
- Two-handed weapons have increased stamina consumption and increased damage
- Skeleton mages now don't try to get close to the player to deal damage.
- NPCs now do not attack other NPCs
- Skeleton mages health is significantly reduced
- added skeletons to the city
- added a knight-mage to the city, which must be killed to open the city gates.
- now to get a scroll you need to pass a small trial
- added more healing candles and creator statues to maps

Also fixed about 100 bugs ːlunar2019shockedpigː

notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
I want to start the New Year with a major update to the game.
I revised and improved almost all the components of the game and in my opinion it has become much better.

- The landscape has been visually reworked and now all locations on the surface look much better.
- Improved combat system.
- Removed weapons requirements.
Now at the start you can use any weapon.
- Fixed main menu.
- Fixed sounds in the game and the moment of their appearance.
- The dungeon became as dark as it was originally and the torch was returned to the player. Which makes it possible to use dynamic lighting and creates a more sinister atmosphere. You can see it in the new trailer.
- Added new models of enemies.
- Also, the game was greatly optimized before its weight was about 5GB, now 1.5GB.
And that's not all.

The game has improved a lot this year and if you played it before, I suggest you do it again.

notes.title: Big game update
notes.notes:
- Redone level structure in the game. Previously, these were levels following each other, now it is a small open world.
- Increased functionality options in the main menu.
- Improved save system.
The combat system is slightly improved.
- Added plot and ghost assistant, which tells the player that he now needs to make where to go.
- Improved the balance of enemies
- Added achievements
- Added new swamp location
- Added new field location
- The city has been added. It plays the role of a central hub to which many portals lead.
And that is not all. In general, the game has more than doubled and the content has become much more.
